name: Foram Shukla
text: We can’t thank you enough for coming out and being part of our wedding! You guys were absolutely amazing from start to finish. Our guests had so much fun with the photo booth, and it added such a personal touch to our special day.One of our favorite parts was getting the printed photo strips. They are such a wonderful keepsake that we’ll treasure for a lifetime. We highly recommend your services to anyone looking to make their event even more special. Thank you again for helping create memories we’ll cherish forever!

name: Jeet Trivedi
text: Really came through for our wedding celebration. The photobooth was definitely the highlight of the night. It was a pleasure working with them, they were very accommodating and offered multiple backdrops to fit the aesthetic of the tent and even customized the printouts to have our names and the date at the bottom! I’m glad they had unlimited prints because all our guests just kept going back! Will definitely be booking Memorii for future events. Couldn’t be happier!

name: Erica Ocampo
text: We enjoyed the service very well, on time, they are very professional and fun to have them in our party. They were also patient w/questions and they have good ideas mockups frames and stuff. Communicate vey well and highly recommend!! Everyone at the party loved their photo booth.

name: Brianna Taylor
text: Great communication, great service, they were very accommodating and had lots of props to choose from. Would definitely hire again for a future event!

name: Hanzalah Patel
text: Had a great time and got some awesome photos. Thanks a lot!!
